approach: Strangler fig at the JCL step: the legacy runner (tools/runjcl/runjcl.py) keeps running every job, SORT and utility step; for a program listed in tools/runjcl/impl/<chain>.json it hands that one step to the Java implementation instead (tools/runjcl/candidate.py). Each chain's "default" field is its cutover / rollback switch, so chains move independently.
